Styling based on visually inspected public fashion photographs:
Angel (Igor Sinyak public evening look): a BLACK SEQUIN EVENING GOWN with a fitted structured off-shoulder neckline, bare shoulders, substantial elegant bodice and long skirt; long dangling crystal earrings; bold winged eyeliner and lipstick; SHORT DARK BRUNETTE hair styled away from the forehead in a glossy sculpted side-swept wave, softly curled back around the ears. Preserve the full face and plus-size body, no slimming. Small translucent fairy wings still visibly belong to him. This is a finished evening dress, not sleepwear or lingerie.
Grey Wiese (Sergey's white lace concert styling photographed for The Blueprint): a voluminous high-neck WHITE LACE MINI TUNIC DRESS, layered scalloped lace tiers and dramatic wide layered sleeves, opaque lining throughout torso and hips, white lace tights and tall glossy WHITE thigh-high heeled BOOTS. Straight shoulder-length-to-collarbone BLOND hair with darker roots, neat center part, both face-framing sides smooth and groomed; visible pointed elf ears. Preserve the recognizable mature male face. This white lace outfit must be visually distinct from his previous black clothes.
Absolutely no suit, blazer, tuxedo, bow tie or pajama outfit on either host.

Action: Angel and Grey are HOSTS recording a funny serious-faced food-and-luxury REVIEW of a wrecked wedding dessert table. Both stand together and animatedly address the CAMERA OF A SEPARATE CAMERAMAN. Angel uses an open presenting palm toward the absurd table; Grey displays a small dessert plate while explaining to the operator's lens. Their hands do not hold any recording equipment. They maintain composed presenter energy despite the ridiculous mess.
The adult cameraman is CLEARLY VISIBLE at the left foreground from a three-quarter rear/side angle, holding a professional video camera with a top microphone and small light aimed toward the duo. He occupies no more than one fifth of frame. Camera lens, cameraman hands and the direction of filming are unmistakable. We see both hosts' faces almost frontally from beside the operator; three-quarter/full-body framing shows the dress silhouettes and Grey's boots. No selfie stick, no smartphones, no selfie composition.

Behind/beside the hosts, a crooked half-demolished tiered cake, an inflatable pool flamingo wearing a party ribbon on the buffet, scattered canapes, overturned champagne bucket and confetti. In the background anonymous adult guests celebrate on a tropical resort terrace. Night, amber lanterns and cool pool lights, lively absurd party atmosphere, realistic skin, true fabric/sequin/lace texture, natural hands, authentic candid photo with subtle grain and direct flash, not illustration, not painterly, not 3D render. All characters are adults, fully clothed, no nudity or sexual acts. Keep both main faces sharp and easily recognizable.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE new 16:9 landscape candid photograph for the end credits of a fantasy role-playing game. Full bleed image only; the application will add a Polaroid frame and handwritten caption. No text or borders in the image.
Reference 1 establishes the EXACT Lord Krayneplot identity and tavern: adult male elf, recognizable face, pointed ears, long chestnut hair with intricate braids, dark green embroidered elven armor with gold leaf details and leather bracers. Reference 2 establishes the EXACT pigeon Kostryulka with his organic light ivory-and-graphite delivery compartment integrated into the back, natural gray pigeon body, iridescent green-violet neck, two ordinary wings and normal bird feet. Keep both designs intact; do not turn the bird into a pot, mammal, toy, giant bird or standalone robot. Keep the back compartment closed.
Scene: a warm candlelit medieval tavern at the end of the evening. Lord Krayneplot sits comfortably at a worn wooden table, with a metal mug nearby. Kostryulka is calmly perched on the table immediately beside him. The Lord gently PETS THE TOP OF THE PIGEON'S HEAD with the fingertips of ONE relaxed hand. This affectionate contact is the single clear main action. He looks at the bird with a small pleased, conspiratorial smile, relaxed shoulders. The pigeon settles happily into the touch, eyes softly narrowed, head slightly tilted toward his fingers. Do not cover the face of the bird or grasp its neck; fingers gently contact only the top/back of the head, natural anatomy.
Medium-close three-quarter composition showing the Lord's face clearly, his upper body, the entire pigeon with closed delivery compartment, and their hand/head contact. Both are the clear focal subjects; no foreground strangers and no extra named characters. The tavern fireplace, timber beams, distant empty chairs and softly blurred candles provide a cozy setting. Low-key warm amber candlelight balanced by subtle photographic fill so faces and feathers read clearly. Cinematic believable photography with real skin, cloth, metal and feather texture, mild candid flash quality consistent with a fantasy party-photo album; no painterly brushwork, illustration or game interface. Light affectionate humor, a quiet satisfied pair after an outrageous adventure. Preserve exact recognizable approved fantasy identity, no caricature, no injury, no logos or watermark.
